warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender D200 Ingenium Timing Chain & DC-DC Converter Issues
paragraphs: If your Defender D200 is an L663 model with the AJ200D Ingenium diesel engine, two well-documented patterns apply. First, the Ingenium diesel family is known for timing chain wear and related component failure. We replace the timing chain, guides, and tensioners as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Second, the D200's mild-hybrid system (MHEV) includes a DC-DC converter which is a single point of failure for the entire 12V electrical system. Failure of this component can cause a complete loss of electrical power. We inspect and replace the DC-DC converter if required as part of our MHEV service.
It's worth noting that the Defender P300 uses the same base 2.0-litre Ingenium engine but without the MHEV system, so it does not share this specific DC-DC converter issue.
warning.source: Source: verified via specialist buying guide (l663.guide) and established specialist pattern. The P300 is explicitly excluded from the MHEV-related DC-DC converter claim per VRF
